data.name: Ghuraibah
data.gender_notes: Ghuraibah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'gharaba', meaning 'to be far away, to leave, to be afraid'. The name Ghuraibah is a feminine form of Ghurab, which means 'the fearless one, the valiant one'. In the context of Islamic tradition, it represents a woman of strength and courage. The name Ghuraibah carries the meaning “Fearless, Valiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghuraibah usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, valiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghuraibah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
